description: instructions — at Stop, a non-blocking note for the user when instruction files are over their size / count caps (caps) or, where a project ships .agent/meta-lint.json, when the meta-lint engine has findings (once per session per distinct text; silent in a linked worktree unless NUDGES_IN_WORKTREE=1); meta-lint --stop separately BLOCKS a file-writing session that leaves a cap breached. Nothing runs at session start. Kill-switches: CAPS_GUARD_OFF=1, META_LINT_OFF=1.

hooks.command: python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/meta-lint" --end-note || echo '{"systemMessage":"⚠️ meta-lint DISARMED — engine failed to run; instruction-system checks did NOT run this session."}'
